cases.rationale: FQ1 guidance midpoint is retained, but a $62.16 constant-share residual tests demand or pricing normalization and concurrent multiple compression.
A $72.16 constant-share residual assumes demand remains strong after guided FQ1 while earnings normalize from the initial quarter; 10x is a sensitivity only.
An $82.16 constant-share residual tests continued AI-memory demand, supply discipline and margins; 12x is an expansion sensitivity only.

asymmetry.qualification: Compares positive bull gain with absolute negative bear loss only; no probabilities or expected return.

assumptions: FY2027 period dates are a 52-week working assumption following FY2026's September 3, 2026 end; exact FY2027 calendar was not independently verified. No FY2027 interim EPS is reported. Micron guided FQ1 FY2027 GAAP diluted EPS of $37.84 plus/minus $1.00. Annual GAAP EPS assumptions use constant split-adjusted diluted shares: bear $100 (EPS remaining after the guidance midpoint $62.16), base $110 ($72.16), bull $120 ($82.16). Bear tests a sharp post-Q1 memory price/margin normalization; base retains strong AI-memory demand but moderates the Q1 pace; bull tests sustained supply discipline and customer demand. P/E inputs 8x/10x/12x are explicit sensitivity assumptions, not observed multiples, fair values, consensus or probabilities.
qualification: All EPS and P/E inputs are analyst assumptions, not observed multiples or consensus. Prices are conditional sensitivities, not forecasts, probabilities or executable quotes. The earnings period differs from the research horizon; assumption and share-basis suitability require review.
